summary: Frontend-only E2E testing of JARVIS Phase 3 (Hero, Builder Intake, Builder Workspace). 44 automated assertions executed via Playwright against the public preview URL at 1920x1080. All 44 passed. Hero MENU exposes exactly Home, Computer, Developer, Media, Builder, Barehands, System; closes on Escape and outside click. Empty hero send is inert; a typed directive is preserved verbatim into builder-objective-text. Intake preserves directive AND app type (Mobile App agent line verified). Intake selectors show a single blue indicator (intake-selected-*) for exactly the chosen type. Timeline shows user + truthful blocked event (runtime=none dispatch=skipped). Composer send disabled when empty, clears field on send, attach/mic show truthful 'not configured' / 'Voice not connected' notices. Non-Builder/Home nav items show '<name> is not connected yet' notice without navigating. Preview default with truthful empty state; Inspect shows 'No source to inspect'; Edit disabled without artifact. Full Screen hides left pane and toggles to 'Exit Full Screen' and back. No 'Launch' or 'Share' controls present on the workspace. No fake progress, percentages, or seeded conversations observed. Behaviour matches all Phase 3 hard rules.
critical_code_review_comments: App.tsx: keydown listener effect depends on `stage` but lint-safe; `returnHome` closure over setStage is fine. Consider adding returnHome to deps or wrapping in useCallback for correctness (minor).

Stage2Workspace.tsx (~407 lines) is nearing the recommended 700-line ceiling; still acceptable but timeline entry rendering could be extracted into a TimelineEntry component to improve reuse/testability.

In Stage2Workspace, IDs use Date.now() which can collide if two entries are added in the same ms (send() adds two with same ts). Recommend crypto.randomUUID() or an incrementing counter to guarantee unique React keys.
